digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter layer - value mappings and boundary enforcement
propositions: Two duplicate dict literals defining ticket-type mappings exist in adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py and adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py, creating risk of silent divergence between Cloud and DC create paths
The existing guard pattern used for STATUS and PRIORITY maps must be extended to cover the TICKET-TYPE map to prevent future duplication
Both duplicate type map definitions must be consolidated into a single canonical definition in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and imported under the historical alias _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE
External consumer test test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py reads outbound_fields._LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE as a module attribute and must remain resolvable without modification
The type mapping must be pinned by value for all four local types (task, story, bug, epic) through both Cloud and DC create paths to prevent regression
